headline: Ben Bernanke on total *subprime losses*
quote: The total losses to the financial system would be about the size
title: Bernanke: Why subprime mortgage losses sparked a market panic
caption: Former Fed Chair Ben Bernanke explains that total subprime mortgage losses were relatively small compared to daily stock market fluctuations. However, widespread uncertainty over where those toxic assets were held triggered a systemic panic.
comment: Did you realize subprime mortgage losses were relatively small before the panic spread?
